name: notify-quiet
prompt: Add a field Quiet bool to notify.Config: when it is true, Broadcast still sends every message but returns no summary lines.

name: notify-send-error
prompt: Sending can fail. Give the Send method of notify.Notifier an error result: Email's Send fails, sending nothing, when the user has no email address, and SMS's Send when the user has no phone; each error message includes the user's name. Broadcast keeps going after a failure, and marks a failed channel in the summary with "!" after its name, as in "Ann: email,sms!".

name: notify-priority
prompt: Messages now have a priority. Add a type notify.Priority with constants Low, Normal and High, in that order. The Send method of notify.Notifier takes a priority as its last parameter, and so does Broadcast, which passes it on. Text messages are sent only for Normal and High priority; email is sent for every priority.

name: notify-userid
prompt: User IDs get a type of their own: the field User.ID becomes a notify.UserID, a string type with a method Valid() bool that reports whether the ID is not empty and has no spaces. Broadcast skips users whose ID is not valid: it sends them nothing and gives them no summary line.

name: notify-sorted
prompt: Broadcast should handle users in order of name, then of ID, whatever order they are given in, without changing the order of the caller's slice.

name: notify-no-logging
prompt: Sending must not write to the standard logger any more: remove the logging from Email and SMS.
